ITEM 1 | Bright red raspberries, clustered in a dome in the center-left of the plate, glossy drupelet surfaces with some pale pinkish-tan tones, slightly soft and juicy-looking, roughly 8 cm across as a cluster | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black blackberries, several whole berries with visible drupelet bumps, matte to slightly glossy, scattered at the upper center and left edge, each about 2.5 cm across | 75
ITEM 3 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow to golden with soft curds and folded clumps, moist-looking with slight sheen, spread along the right side of the plate in a mound about 9 cm by 6 cm and about 2 cm high, no visible browning | 105
ITEM 4 | Cubes of yellow-orange fruit (likely cut melon or mango style pieces), smooth cut faces with slight translucency and juice sheen, arranged in a loose row along the lower right, each piece about 2.5 cm across and 1.5 cm tall | 90
ITEM 5 | Thin brown-red cured or cooked meat slices, dense and slightly glossy surface with darker edges, two pieces lying at the lower center and top right, each about 6 cm long, 2.5 cm wide and about 0.5 cm thick | 60
